entities.name: Ismaël de Lesseps
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ferdinand Marie Ismaël de Lesseps, known as Ismaël de Lesseps, was a French fencer. He competed in the individual and team sabre events at the 1908 Summer Olympics. He was killed in action during World War I. He was the brother of Bertrand Marie de Lesseps and son of Ferdinand de Lesseps.
